title: Minecraft Air Defense just got a HUGE Upgrade
description:
As it turns out the anti-air autocannon would not be out of commission for long as in this video we discover how a new mechanism could bring the cannon back. We even go as far as giving the cannon new capabilities such as higher precision for accuracy and the ability to fire a large burst of multiple rounds turning what was a cool concept into a new deadly super-weapon.

Be sure to watch the original video for more information about the build process:
https://youtu.be/Q_MkxSD33Vw?t=1578

Also watch these videos to learn more about the cannons mechanics:
